title: Lua learning roadmap

stages.label: Foundation
stages.goal: Write small standalone scripts and reason about syntax, values, operators and control flow.

stages.label: Reusable programming
stages.goal: Build functions and table-based models, process text/files, organize modules and handle failures.

stages.label: Advanced language patterns
stages.goal: Understand metatables, object/functional patterns, coroutines, memory and trust boundaries.

stages.label: Professional workflow
stages.goal: Test, lint, document, version, package and maintain a Lua codebase.

stages.label: Embedding and ecosystem
stages.goal: Explore the C API and optional framework/host-specific paths.

stages.label: Modernization
stages.goal: Verify Lua 5.5 changes and plan compatibility tests for older releases and LuaJIT.

dependency_policy: Modules are sequenced; each lesson points to its immediate predecessor. Specialist modules also require the relevant programming fundamentals.
